evidence.excerpt: On 456 released $τ^2$-bench telecom trajectories, the benchmark oracle flags 231 runs; adding a rule checker, a support stand-in, and a prefix-monitor baseline raises the union to 391, 401, and 407, each contributing flags the others miss, and a gate makes one prohibition exact on a gated deployment.
